participation.context: Priced the road, read Anne's side, and set twopence against sixpence.

story.body: You heard Anne's letter, you left her jokes unanswered, and you did not repay Quiney's two pound.

title: Took Anne's letter at the Bell

participation.context: Wrote the line on the corner and signed it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Waited while the ink was wet enough to read.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

participation.context: The person the paper is for. She is not at the table.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You added one sentence to the three you had carried since Sunday, and you stopped.

title: Wrote the fourth line at the Bell

participation.context: Looked, and was not in the frame.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked back at the horses still steaming, and the half-sheet with the fourth line was on the table inside.

title: Looked back at the steaming horses and the half-sheet
